nodes.description: Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; gates init, setTradeAddress, batchSend, delegate and _mints.
Public token balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, batchSend, constructor and _mints.
Public nested allowance mapping read/written by approve and transferFrom (including unchecked decrement).
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and checked by condition.
Whitelist mapping granting unconditional transfer rights in ensure and set by _mints.
Max number of sales allowed per address, configured by init and read by condition.
Minimum sale amount, configured by init with unchecked multiplication and read by condition.
Maximum sale amount, configured by init with unchecked multiplication and read by condition.
Whitelisted trading address, owner-controlled and used as a bypass in ensure.
Total supply of UniswapExchange, set once in constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale amounts in init, _mints and constructor.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address that is always whitelisted in ensure and given max allowance in constructor.
Private balances mapping of the standard ERC20 base contract.
Private nested allowances mapping of the standard ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply of the standard ERC20 base contract.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender to the transferFrom implementation.
Whitelist gate: bypasses all restrictions for owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses; otherwise calls condition.
Public payable transfer implementation performing allowance and balance updates with unchecked arithmetic plus ensure() gating.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] without any restriction.
Enforces sale count and min/max sale amount limits using sale configuration state.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and bytecode.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address, sets balance from unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only sale-parameter initialisation using unchecked scaling multiplications.
Owner-only batch transfer loop computing total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and emitting transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation used by ensure to compute the whitelisted pair.
Sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, initial balance and unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Standard ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer.
Internal ERC20 balance movement with SafeMath and non-zero address checks.
Performs an unchecked low-level call to an external token contract and decodes the returned bool.
Constructor storing name, symbol and decimals metadata.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance checks and initial mint in constructor.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address allowing full storage takeover by a compromised owner.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked balance overwrite balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) in _mints.
address(token).call(data) low-level call inside callOptionalReturn enabling arbitrary external execution.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Parameter _from of transferFrom and ensure: source account, fully attacker-controlled.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: destination account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount used in unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Parameter spender of _mints: address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted.
Parameter addedValue of _mints: scaled by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: recipient array whose length multiplies _value unchecked.
Parameter _value of batchSend: per-recipient amount used in the unchecked total multiplication.
Local variable total in batchSend holding the unchecked product of _value and array length.
Parameter a of delegate: target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Local variable _UNI in ensure holding the computed Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist bypass.
Parameter saleNum of init assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init scaled unchecked into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init scaled unchecked into _maxSale.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as _from to transferFrom.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and spender lookup in transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before moving balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decrements and increments balanceOf entries.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is unchecked.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist bypass applies.
ensure derives the whitelisted pair via pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)).
ensure grants unconditional transfer if _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants unconditional transfer if _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure grants unconditional transfer if canSale[_from] is true.
ensure always whitelists the hardcoded UNI router address.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate performs an external arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-influenced calldata.
_mints is restricted to owner or a hardcoded privileged address via msg.sender.
_mints overwrites balances with addedValue*(10**decimals) without overflow checks.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting permanent transfer bypass.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] directly.
init requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
init computes _minSale = token*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
init computes _maxSale = maxToken*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
init assigns _saleNum = saleNum.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend deducts from and credits balanceOf entries in a loop.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, permanently granting privileged functions.
Constructor assigns owner.
Constructor assigns totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner without restrictions.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sale amount.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
callOptionalReturn executes an external low-level call to a token address before state finalisation.
ERC20._transfer updates the private _balances mapping.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
transfer ultimately moves UniswapExchange balances via transferFrom.
Parameter _from feeds the allowance, whitelist and balance logic of transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Parameter addedValue flows into the unchecked mint assignment.
Parameter b supplies arbitrary calldata to the delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only exists to be consumed by transferFrom's allowance, ensure and balance logic.
Parameter _to is only used as the credit target inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value is only used for the transferFrom amount checks and unchecked subtractions.
Parameter spender only indexes balanceOf and canSale inside _mints.
Parameter addedValue only supplies the checked-off mint amount in _mints.
Parameter _tos only drives the batchSend loop and its length-based total.
Parameter _value only sizes the per-recipient credit in batchSend.
Local total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Parameter a is the direct target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b is the direct calldata payload of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Local _UNI is only used as a whitelist bypass value inside ensure.
Parameter saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
Parameter token is only scaled unchecked into _minSale inside init.
Parameter maxToken is only scaled unchecked into _maxSale inside init.
